start_here: Say to your AI: "Commit what is chosen for the next commit in a project on the person's computer, with a message", with {"folder":"/projects/sample","message":"Sample commit"}. It runs tool:commit-changes and answers {"folder":"/projects/sample","branch":"main","ahead":1,"behind":0,"changes":[{"file_path":"notes.txt","bucket":"unstaged","status":"M"},{"file_path":"scratch.txt","bucket":"untracked","status":"?"}]}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Commit what is chosen for the next commit in a project on the person's computer, with a message", and give it folder; message.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:commit-changes and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give folder (the full path of the project folder the person has let this tool use) and message (what this commit says).
